verdict.rationale: Smooth is built for programmatic, non-interactive use. It offers REST endpoints for browser automation, a four-line SDK task runner, polling-based task status, and endpoints to list and cancel tasks. Its official CLI works with any agent that can run CLI commands, so it can be scripted in pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions examples, non-interactive API-key/env-var auth guidance) and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
